tagline: Istanbul's northern business district — corporate towers, tech companies, and a growing leisure scene anchored by Sapphire Tower and the surrounding malls.

items.name: Sapphire Tower Cafés
items.description: Multiple café options in and around the Sapphire Tower complex. The observation deck café has extraordinary city views.
items.tip: The Sapphire observation deck (Istanbul Sapphire) gives the best 360° view of Istanbul on a clear day. Worth the entrance fee.

items.name: Kanyon ve Maslak AVM Restoranları
items.description: Multiple restaurants in the Maslak shopping centres catering to business lunches and after-work dining.

items.name: İstanbul Sapphire (Observation Deck)
items.description: The observation deck of Istanbul's tallest building — panoramic views of both continents, the Bosphorus, and on clear days, the Black Sea and Marmara simultaneously.

tips: Maslak is the last stop on the M2 metro line — direct to Taksim and the city centre.
Primarily a corporate area. Better for business than leisure.
The Sapphire observation deck is the main tourist attraction — worth a visit for the views.
The forest areas of Belgrad Ormanı are accessible from Maslak by taxi (about 20 min).
